text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool. It copies tables from Postgres to S3, in Parquet format. You can run a sync one time, or on a schedule. sqlpipe reads the schema of the source table and converts each column to the matching Parquet type.

Configuration is a single YAML file. The file lists the source connection, the target bucket, and the tables to sync. sqlpipe can sync a full table, or only rows that changed since the last run. If a sync fails, sqlpipe retries the sync up to three times. After three failed attempts, sqlpipe stops and writes the error to the log.
